verdict.seen: Muddy orange car under the car wash roof; a white-bubble hose spray appears at the car's front in frames 2 and 3.
Mud blobs spread along the car's side across the frames while the hose spray fades out; the car stays muddy.
An arch with blue and red cloth rollers appears over the car, with soap spray lines under the top bar.
Soap bubbles flow across the lot to the drain, then a pipe of blue dots runs below ground to the creek.
A floor drain grate is cut into the ground and a blue tank appears below it, with bubbles at the drain.
Blue water rises in the tank, a yellow outline traces it, and a brown pipe enters from the drain above.
Sand settles as a yellow layer on the floor, a dark oil layer sits on top, the water clears, and a pump outlet shows at the left.
A white pipe runs from the tank's pump up the left side and along the wall toward the arch, extending across the frames.
The arch with the car and a blue water puddle and a small spray are in view, with the reclaim tank at left.
The arch with blue and red rollers is clearly in view, with a hose beside it.
A kiosk and a yellow vacuum station appear, then black canopy posts rise on the right; the roof is not yet fully visible in the last frame.
The whole car wash is in view with its arch, tank, pipes, kiosk, vacuum station and green canopy, with nothing covering it.
